title: Home-Site Lease Renewal Pricing Rider: Payment-Record Adjustment
content:
**Rider to Home-Site Lease renewal pricing — payment record**

A payment-record adjustment, in percentage points, is added to the renewal increase rate of a Home-Site Lease renewal offer. It turns on the late fees posted on the lease with an entry date in the trailing 12 calendar months, read on the day the offer is issued.

| Late fees posted on the lease in the trailing 12 calendar months | Payment-record adjustment |
|---|---|
| none | -0.6 percentage points |
| exactly one | -0.3 percentage points |
| two or more | zero |

A negative adjustment lowers the renewal increase rate by that many points: -0.6 means 0.6 points lower, -0.3 means 0.3 points lower.

**The thresholds on both sides**

- Zero late fees and one late fee fall on different rows: zero gives -0.6, one gives -0.3.
- One late fee and two late fees fall on different rows: one gives -0.3, two gives zero, as do three or more.
- Only late fees with an entry date inside the trailing 12 calendar months count; a late fee posted before that window is not counted.

**Hypothetical applications** (renewal increase rate of 5.0 percent assumed for illustration)

| Late fees in the window | Adjustment | Rate after this adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | -0.6 | 4.4 percent |
| 1 | -0.3 | 4.7 percent |
| 2 | 0 | 5.0 percent |
